messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Veridian Health says the enterprise credit from their PO note never landed on their account. Trial expired, now they're getting overage charges. PO and SOW attached.
Daniel Park: I logged a CRM note and added the PO reference on 2026-03-10. Did the billing pipeline pick this up? customer_id: cust_veer_987
Alex Ruiz: I don't see any ledger transaction. Can you paste the PO note text and the invoice id?
Maya Chen: PO note: "PO# VH-5521 — apply enterprise promotional credit per SOW section 4.2". Invoice: INV-2026-117. Ticket CS-6329. Customer saw API error when trying to redeem: `error: promo_not_applicable`.
BillingBot: [auto] billing anomaly detected: promo-apply-fail event for cust_veer_987 at 2026-03-11T14:08Z, rule: po_note_parser_v2
Olivia Gupta: Trying to repro in staging now — created a mock PO note and hit the promo-apply endpoint, got 400. Logs below.

```
POST /v1/customers/cust_veer_987/credits/apply
body: { "note": "PO# VH-5521 — apply enterprise promotional credit" }
response 400 { "code": "promo_not_applicable", "details": "no matching contract promo" }
```

Olivia Gupta: Looks like parser didn't map the PO note to the contract promo id (promo_id: null).
Samir Patel: Pinging @eng-runtime — any recent changes to po_note_parser_v2? logs show a parse exception at 2026-03-10T03:12:06Z. Stack: `KeyError('contract_ref')` from parse_po_note().
eng-runtime-bot: Deploy 2026-03-09 v2.4.1 included a stricter schema for PO parser. Rolling back v2.4.1 on canary to validate.
Daniel Park: I attached the signed SOW in CRM and left a comment with the intended promo id: PROMO-ENT-VERIDIAN-2026. Sales instructed manual grant if auto-apply failed.
Alex Ruiz: Finance approval needed for manual credits > $5k. Contract amount is $6,500. Please provide sales approval record.
Daniel Park: Sales confirmation DM from Veridian CEO at 2026-03-09T11:02 — I will forward the email chain to finance@redwood and cc Maya.
Maya Chen: Created billing ticket BILL-8743 and uploaded SOW + sales approval.
Alex Ruiz: Finance approves one-off manual adjustment pending documentation. Create ledger TX with memo: "Manual credit per PO VH-5521; PROMO-ENT-VERIDIAN-2026" and adj id ADJ-2026-VER-001.
BillingBot: [auto] Ledger adjustment queued: ADJ-2026-VER-001 for cust_veer_987 amount $6500. Status: pending-post.
Alex Ruiz: Posted. TX id: TX-9001123. Memo matches. Status: posted.
Maya Chen: Notified Veridian — they confirmed balance updated and overage reversed. They requested a brief root-cause writeup.
Samir Patel: Root cause: strict schema validation in po_note_parser_v2 rejected legacy PO phrasing when `contract_ref` token missing. Reverted parser to v2.4.0 on canary and opened PR #4235 to make parser tolerant of legacy notes and add unit tests.
Daniel Park: I'll follow up with the customer timeline and copy Finance for invoice reconciliation.
Olivia Gupta: Plan to close CS-6329 after customer confirmation. Will include ledger TX id and remediation notes in closure.
Maya Chen: Customer confirmed by email. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
